products.title: BUDGEE - 900mm
products.body_html:

products.title: BOMBIERA - 1200mm
products.body_html:
Bombiera Vanity, a charming and versatile solution for bathrooms seeking a balance of style and practicality. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this wall-hung vanity exudes sophistication while offering functionality tailored to your needs.

Elevate your bathroom decor with the Bombiera Vanity's timeless design, featuring clean lines and a contemporary aesthetic that effortlessly complements any space. Constructed with the finest materials, this vanity boasts exceptional quality and durability, ensuring it remains a focal point in your bathroom for years to come.

The Bombiera Vanity is designed with a unique configuration, featuring top-level drawers and an open shelf. This innovative design caters to bathrooms with minimal storage needs, providing convenient access to essentials while offering a stylish platform for displaying decorative items or towels.

Finished with precision and care, the Bombiera Vanity is adorned with a luxurious Osmo Polyx Hardwax oil finish, enhancing the natural beauty of the wood while offering protection against moisture and daily use. This premium finish adds a touch of sophistication to your bathroom space, elevating its ambiance with understated elegance.

Experience the perfect blend of form and function with the Bombiera Vanity. Whether you're seeking a storage solution for a compact bathroom or looking to add a touch of elegance to your space, this exceptional piece of furniture is sure to exceed your expectations. Redefine your bathroom decor with the Bombiera Vanity and enjoy the perfect combination of style and practicality.

products.title: MILROY - 900mm
products.body_html:
Milroy Vanity, a sleek and sustainable addition to your bathroom space. Crafted from recycled Australian hardwood, this wall-hung vanity embodies eco-conscious elegance while offering exceptional functionality.

Designed with a modern aesthetic in mind, the Milroy Vanity features a minimalist silhouette that effortlessly complements any contemporary decor. Its sturdy construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the use of recycled hardwood underscores a commitment to environmental responsibility.

The vanity is meticulously finished with Osmo Polyx Hardwax oil, enhancing the natural beauty of the wood while providing protection against moisture and everyday wear and tear. This premium finish not only preserves the integrity of the vanity but also adds a luxurious touch to your bathroom ambiance.

With two levels of drawers, the Milroy Vanity maximizes storage space, allowing you to organize your essentials with ease. Whether it's toiletries, towels, or other bathroom essentials, you'll find ample room to keep everything neatly tucked away, promoting a clutter-free environment.

Upgrade your bathroom with the Milroy Vanity and indulge in sustainable luxury that's both visually stunning and functionally superior. Experience the perfect fusion of style, durability, and eco-conscious design with this exceptional piece of furniture.
